use_case_summary: LatticeCode is building an IDE copilot that can run developer tooling (tests, linters, type-checkers) via agent function-calls inside a secure sandbox. Key asks: sub-100ms token streaming for completions, ability to pin models/versions for deterministic suggestions, safe ephemeral execution for test runs with audit logs, per-route cost visibility, and seamless local/on-prem deployment options for enterprise customers.
notes:
- Primary product: Copilot-like assistant embedded in their cloud IDE for internal and enterprise customers.
- Wants function-calling agent patterns: 'run-tests', 'lint-file', 'collect-build-logs'. These calls must run in an isolated sandbox per invocation; no network egress allowed except to approved artifact store.
- Security: strict requirement for KMS-backed keys, per-run audit trail, retention controls (30/90/365d toggles), and SSO+SCIM.
- Architecture ask: prefer Redwood Private control plane deployed in their VPC or an on-prem bundle for air-gapped installations. Dedicated GPU pool for low-latency streaming of completions and to pin model versions across environments.
- Performance: Latency SLOs: initial target median < 120ms for single-line completions, tail < 500ms for short-context streaming. Throughput: 100 concurrent dev sessions per region.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit for reserved capacity if unit economics clear; wants Optimize recommendations for batching/caching vs model quality tradeoffs.
- Canary/rollback: must support model pinning and canary rollouts across teams (dev/staging/prod) with traffic splits and automatic fallback to stable model.
- Sandbox specifics discussed: OCI-based ephemeral containers, strict seccomp/profile, CPU/memory caps, filesystem mount only to ephemeral workspace, artifacts pushed to approved S3 bucket with integrity checks.
- Dev ask: function-call payloads should include trace-id and provenance headers for linking logs back to tokens and eval datasets.
- POC plan: 2-week sandbox POC. Week 1: integrate Redwood SDK, validate model pin + streaming latency. Week 2: run a suite of 1k sample tests via function-calls to validate isolation, resource limits, and audit logs.
- Quote from engineering: "We need to be able to reproduce a single completion + test run from a commit hash — auditability is non-negotiable."
- Sales notes: legal will push for stronger indemnity language due to remote code execution; propose limited scope + run-time guardrails.
- Suggested next actions: schedule on-prem install feasibility call with infra (Alex R.), provide security appendix and HSM/KMS integration guide, create sample POC repo with function-calling handlers for 'run-tests' and 'collect-build-logs'.
